description: ennyn. In every session: record the plugin version the session runs in the plugin's own data folder and name it to the session's commands (ENNYN_PLUGIN_DATA, ENNYN_PLUGIN_ROOT), which a commit-msg hook installed from the plugin follows; this reads nothing of the project. Everything else only in a project with an Ennyn config (.ennyn/config.json at the repository's top, or the file ENNYN_CONFIG names; anywhere else those hooks end at once, printing and writing nothing): refuse every git push but a plain one the project's ask rule reads for certain, reading the command's text and running none of it; refuse a kill chosen by a filter, a name, a window title, a port or a PID looked up at run time (pkill, killall, taskkill /IM or /FI, Stop-Process -Name, kill of a substitution, xargs kill, fuser -k), so an agent stops only a process it started, by its PID or process group, reading text the same way; inject the project's path-scoped rules when a file tool touches a side copy (git worktree or plain copy) of it; forget them after compaction or /clear so they come back, a list left from an earlier config too; give the session the conversation style the config sets; before compaction, hold idle compaction alone, while a task is mid-way and below a ceiling under the context limit, and ask every summary for the task, its files and its next step, giving it the changed file names; this reads the end of the session's transcripts and asks git for names and times, sending no tracked file's content through a filter (git reads .gitignore) and running none of the repository's code; after compaction, ask the agent to re-read the files its task changed and its impact table before its next edit, a fixed line that names no file, and, when the work tree's cycle journal in the state dir is open, one line of the cycle's state that names no file's content (`compaction.defer: false` turns all of this off, before and after compaction); after /clear and at a session's startup, that line, or once the cycle is closed one of the closed cycle that names the handoff's path from the config. No hook makes a network call.
